'''K Sandeep''' (born 3 April 1973) is an Indian mathematician specialising in [[elliptic partial differential equations]]. He was awarded the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], the highest science award in India, for the year 2015 in mathematical science category. He is affiliated to the [[TIFR Centre for Applicable Mathematics]], [[Bangalore]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Brief Profile of the Awardee|url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/Detail.aspx?AID=510|website=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize|publisher=CSIR Human Resource Development Group, New Delhi|access-date=4 November 2015}}</ref>
